summary: Connect Advisors is a Docklands (Melbourne) accounting and business services firm offering tax, SMSF, outsourced CFO, bookkeeping and forensic accounting. Anna Wijeyesinghe, a Chartered Accountant and Xero Certified Advisor with Financial Controller and virtual CFO experience, was appointed Company Director in January 2025. The firm serves clients from multinationals to start-ups.

hooks.text: Anna has implemented policies and software systems as a Financial Controller, so she will care about traceability and controls in any reconciliation tool.
